text.ヴィンテージマンションとして名高い広尾ガーデンヒルズの、目の前に広がる杜の景観を: An apartment renovation at Hiroo Garden Hills, the well-known vintage block, drawing in the woodland that opens up in front of it, for the ease of a summer retreat. Lime plaster and wool-linen carpet are joined by a solid teak wall running between the greenery east and west, which brings the comfort of natural materials further forward. An Oya stone accent set into the teak wall carries a small niche for an object or some flowers. A glass door divides the living room from the study, so that each can sense the other: a home full of ease and of kindness.
text.15ミリの厚さの無垢チークを使用。天然オイルで仕上げており、時とともに木自体の油: Solid teak 15 mm thick, finished in natural oil; with time the oils in the timber itself deepen the colour and the sheen.
text.リビングから書斎までのウォールパネルは、東西それぞれの緑地を繋ぐ役割をしています: The panelling, running from the living room to the study, ties together the green space to the east and to the west.
